entry.title: Fraud and scams advisory: November 2026
entry.summary: Scammers are using AI-generated voices to impersonate family members who say they are in trouble and need money urgently.
entry.content:
Scammers are using AI-generated voices to impersonate family members who say they are in trouble and need money urgently.

To protect yourself, set up a family code word that only relatives know, and hang up and call back on a number you already have.

entry.title: New Gemini feature helps spot scam messages
entry.summary: A new Gemini feature on Android can flag text messages that look like scams before you reply.
entry.content:
A new Gemini feature on Android can flag text messages that look like scams before you reply.

To turn it on, open Messages settings and enable Scam Detection.
